raw_prompt: Make me a pen holder for my desk.

ground_truth.prompt: Design a cylindrical desktop pen/pencil holder: 65 mm outer diameter x 95 mm tall, with 3 mm walls and a 3 mm solid flat base. Fully open top, no lid. Single watertight FDM-printable solid — no drainage or mounting holes needed. Print base-down with the open top facing up; no supports required.
process_notes: 3 mm wall thickness and matching 3 mm base thickness balance rigidity, stability, and print time for a small FDM part.
Fully open top with no lid, for easy insertion/removal of pens and pencils.
No drainage or mounting holes: unlike a planter this holds dry items only and is a free-standing desk object, not wall-mounted.
Single watertight solid (cylindrical wall + flat base) suitable for direct slicing; genus-0 mesh with no through-holes.
Inner diameter of roughly 59 mm (outer 65 mm minus 2x3 mm walls) comfortably fits several standard pens/pencils (8-10 mm diameter each) upright without crowding.
Print oriented base-down with the open top facing up; the constant circular cross-section and vertical walls need no supports.
